admission.justification: Prevent treating intentional Writer limits as unresolved defects or declaring the curation complete after editing instructions alone.

applicability: Curator instructions and the L54 Writer-contract/by-design reconciliation boundary.
conditions: The ordinary handoff requires the persisted leaf worklist, same-document attachment, truthful refusal reporting and current reconsideration recovery.
Rejected simplifications are recorded as chosen current design plus actual rejected option/reason, not deferred defects; instruction publication alone does not finish decision reconciliation.
exclusions: No invented alternative, CODE execution grade, generated-copy migration completion or independent acceptance.
statement: Curator guidance must state the changed Writer contracts and curation must record each continuing by-design choice with the actual rejected alternative and its reason.
